description: The performer holds a Nintendo Switch console with a blue Joy-Con attached to the left rail over a white table, pressing the release/latch button on the top rear of the Joy-Con.
The performer is assembling a white metal IKEA Gladom tray table frame, holding one of the intersecting tubular white metal legs and adjusting its position relative to the central pivot joint.
An HP DeskJet all-in-one printer rests on a light wooden desk; the performer reaches toward the output tray to grab a freshly printed test page.

The performer is assembling a white metal IKEA Gladom tray table frame upside down on a white round table, carefully threading a black hex socket head screw by hand through the circular leg attachment ring into the leg tube.

transcript: Nice! Well done. Now please attach the lens again.
description: On a white round table, the performer places down a black Canon DSLR camera body with neck strap while holding the detached Canon zoom lens upright on the table next to an SD card and battery pack.

The performer is disassembling a black IKEA Knarrevik nightstand on a round white table; while unscrewing, a small black hex socket head screw slips from their fingers and drops onto the table surface next to their hand.

transcript: Please continue by putting the legs in a reverse way on the plate.
description: The performer is assembling a white IKEA Marius stool at a workbench with tools on the pegboard; they reach to place a white plastic washer/spacer on the stool leg, but position it incorrectly (prompting instructor intervention: 'Please continue by putting the legs in a reverse way on the plate.').

The performer is assembling a black IKEA Knarrevik nightstand, trying to screw a hex socket head into the joint between the shelf and vertical frame with their fingers, but struggles with alignment/cross-threading the bolt into the metal frame hole.

The performer mounts a GoPro action camera onto a Rollei head/chest strap bracket, attempting to insert the long thumbscrew from the right side rather than the correct threaded side, causing improper engagement.

transcript: To the black mark in match on the camera and the lens.
description: The performer holds an open Canon EOS 1300D body with exposed sensor/mirror in their right hand, and the zoom lens in their left hand, inspecting them while trying to figure out how to align the lens mount (instructor guides: 'To the black mark in match on the camera and the lens.').
